# How War Changed Rondo

How War Changed Rondo (Ukrainian: ; translit. Viina, shcho zminyla Rondo) is a Ukrainian picture book written and illustrated by the artists Romana Romanyshyn and Andriy Lesiv. It was first published in Ukraine in 2015 by Vydavnytstvo Staroho Leva.
Awards and recognition
*The book won the prestigious Bologna Ragazzi Award in 2015.
*Selected for The White Ravens catalogue (2015)
*Included on USBBY’s  list (2022)
